note: Pragmatics gold for the DC underlay/overlay cross-domain case: the authoritative SOURCE OF TRUTH (realm) for each shared field at the binding seam. X = Lattice (fabric/underlay), Y = Vertex (overlay), shared = a co-owned binding. Semantic correspondence at the seam is necessary but not sufficient; provisioning also requires respecting whose realm owns each field's value, and the characteristic pragmatic error is letting the wrong realm govern.

fields.why: the tenant segment's identity is owned by the overlay (the VNI is fabric-wide and stable); the fabric picks a LOCAL VLAN to carry it on a given leaf, so the authoritative segment identity is the overlay's, not the local VLAN number
the tenant's default-gateway address and its distributed (anycast) placement are programmed by the overlay controller; the fabric realises an SVI but does not choose the address
the MTU actually carried is a physical property of the fabric; the overlay states a minimum for its encapsulation, but the authoritative realised value is the fabric side's
the fabric attachment and the VTEP binding are two names for one co-owned binding point; neither side's local naming overrides the other, they must agree it is the same point
